title: Always the Amusement Park
content: Just woke up from a very vivid dream where I visited the amusement park again. This time I was checking out of a hotel attached to the park but there were some complications which required me to talk to the people working hotel + park. The park was attached to the hotel in a very open-air kind of way. I could see parts of the park from one of the areas where people order food, then sit and eat. It was very cafeteria style where everyone carried a green plastic tray. I woke up right after ordering two drinks. (Similar to mimosas, but on-theme with the park.) I have never visited the mall or even the water park but I frequently visit this amusement park. Does anyone else have the same experiences? Sorry if I broke the rules; first time posting, long time lurker, you get the drill.
